name: skip_dialogues
comment: The port's skip_dialogues mod (docs/LAUNCHER_MODS_PLAN.md 5.2), run by tests/port/mods.py with the mod on from the start: first_battle_save's route with no press through the scenes, one press for each choice after 300 idle frames. Port-only (the emulator has no mods).

steps.comment: CNTY_SEL (overlay_files[22]) loaded: the country / language select

START until the opening movie's map: confirms the default choice 0 = English (cnty_sel_languages[0] = 2 = ENG), records_language 2, once the panels have slid in and the cursor is up (cnty_sel_update_menu step 7 is the only step that reads START, the fade-out steps ignore it); the EU game then goes to map 0xE02 = the opening movie
STDWTITL loaded (map 0xE02, stdwtitl_movie_screen for movie 1)

START skips the movie (stdwtitl_update_movie checks pad pressed bit 3). On the dynarec core the player spins in StGetNext and samples the pad rarely (the STR stream never reaches its last frame), so a short tap can fall between two samples: hold 30 / release 30 until the title screen proper (map 0xE00). On -interpreter the movie decodes normally and the first press skips it

the logo slides in, shines and glows; START opens the New Game / Continue menu only at stdwtitl_menu step 2 (600 ticks there without START start the demo), every other step ignores it, so tap START for 800 frames instead of waiting a fixed time
the menu blinks and the two choices slide out (steps 3-5: 12 + 15 + 6 ticks)
cursor 0 = New Game (the menu opens on cursor 1 = Continue)
confirm until FIELDSTG is loaded: physical CROSS is logical bit 13 (PAD_PRESSED(0xD)) for non-Japanese languages; stdwtitl_title_apply_choice case 1: gamestate_new_game, set_next_map(0x2D7)
no press: the intro's scenes (maps 0x2D7, 0x2D8) go on by themselves to the registration (STPLNMET, map 0x500); with the mod off the first dialogue waits forever
the registration needs presses (CROSS types the name; the default partner set): CROSS until the login movie's map (first_battle_save step 9)

steps.name: login_movie
steps.comment: after the registration: the name, the partner set and the three Digimon records are in gamestate_data

skip the login movie at once with one long START hold, as new_game did first. The dynarec core's STR playback is fragile: waiting 150 frames first, or tapping every 30 frames, made the emulated machine run off (reads from 0x17FF0500, a reset, then 'Unrecoverable error while running recompiler' at PC 0xFF050014), at speed 1 too
no press: the arrival scenes in Asuka (map 0x207, WSTAG225) to the Main Lobby
Main Lobby (map 0x203, WSTAG210; positions from its attribute map, layer 0): down the ramp (the player can move once the arrival scene ends)
up the stairs
below the Tamer Service counter (actor 49 at (361, 221))
face the counter (direction 5, as event 13 places the player)
the facing press done (a talk press right after it is not taken)
one press: talk to Tamer Service; the greeting ('Welcome. Here you can look at hints ...') goes on and closes by itself, and the NPC is not talked to again

one press: talk again ('Then should I call out your partner Digimon?'), which goes on by itself to the question 'Download your partner Digimon now? Yes, please! / Not yet.' (wstag210_choice_9_update: code, not a control code)
the question must wait: no answer is picked

steps.name: tamer_choice
steps.comment: still in the Main Lobby (map 0x203): the choice waited
one press: 'Yes, please!' (the default) leads to the admin room
no press: the admin room scene (map 0x204, WSTAG212), the walk to Asuka City (map 0x200) and its event, to the first battle (FIGHTSTG)

steps.name: battle_start
steps.comment: FIGHTSTG loaded: the scripted first battle of the story (one enemy)
CROSS on the battle's menus (Fight, the technique, the target); its messages go on by themselves

steps.name: battle_won
steps.comment: STFGTREP (the battle report) loaded: HP/MP after the battle, records_battle_results; the experience is not added yet
through the report

steps.name: battle_end
steps.comment: back in FIELDSTG (map 0x200): the report has added the experience (stfgtrep_add_exp, level-ups and their stat draws)
no press: the post-battle scene in Asuka City, which ends in the lab (map 0x206)
the lab (map 0x206, WSTAG220): down the stairs to the exit to Asuka City
an exit (FieldstgMapEvent type 1) is taken with CROSS while standing on it (fieldstg_map_events_update)
Asuka City (map 0x200, WSTAG200), arriving at (1040, 512): along the lower street
the foot of the stairs
up to the upper street
the door to map 0x20A
Asuka Inn (map 0x20A, WSTAG235): to the save attendant (actor 21 at (175, 192))
face her (direction 3, as event 1200 places the player)
one press: talk to the save attendant (event 1200); her dialogue goes on by itself to the question
the inn's question must wait

steps.name: inn_choice
steps.comment: still in the inn (map 0x20A, FIELDSTG): the choice waited
one press: accept
no press: STGMCARD in save mode
